svg.title: Resistance of a uniform cylinder
svg.desc: A uniform cylinder of length L, cross-sectional area A and resistivity ρ is equivalent to a resistor R = ρL/A. The longer the cylinder, the greater its resistance; the larger its area, the smaller its resistance. An animated companion below illustrates the process; its complete static alternative is shown for reduced motion and print.

g.text: First increase L; then increase cross-sectional A
R = ρL/A; I = V/R; ρ = 1 μΩ·m; V = 5 V
Material, temperature, and applied voltage stay fixed. Doubling L doubles R; then doubling A halves
R. Radius scales with the square root of area.
Illustrative motion • slowed down • cycle restarts
